title: Stained Glass Portrait
description: A hand-drawn blue line portrait of a bald person with wide eyes and open mouth is centered within a stained glass window design. The figure is surrounded by radiating blue rays, orange flowers at the base, and a bright yellow sun against a red sky, all framed by a colorful mosaic of square panels containing various small illustrations.
prompt: A striking surreal portrait of a bald androgynous figure with intense wide eyes and open mouth rendered in bold blue ink lines, centered inside a vibrant stained glass window. Bright yellow sun with rays above, red sky, orange flowers with green stems at the bottom, radiating blue light beams, all framed by a mosaic of small colorful square panels containing tiny illustrations, drawn on notebook paper with spiral binding visible.
